release.runtimeMismatch: bundling Python %(version)s requires a 64-bit Windows builder running the same Python major/minor version
#: What release.py says while it builds the archive - read by whoever builds a release.
release.noFolder: could not find %(name)s; name its folder with an argument, or get it from %(source)s
release.noPart: %(name)s has no %(part)s in %(folder)s - the add-on is not the one expected
release.notTheFolder: %(folder)s has no %(files)s in it - this is not %(name)s
release.optList: what would go into the archive, doing nothing
release.optNoVendor: no third-party code at all: the workbench alone
release.optOut: where to put it; target/packages by default
release.optStageOnly: stage the folder and do not pack it
release.tpIntro: morphbench is under the GNU GPL 3 (LICENSE next to this file). The package also carries work by other people:
release.tpOwnBody: The installed Python and JavaScript are runtime source. SOURCE.md identifies the exact maintained Morphbench source commit and separately available launcher source/build directions. Preserve the bundled licence and source-availability notices.
release.usage:
Building the release: one self-contained archive of the workbench.

    python release.py                      build into build\ and pack
    python release.py --version 0.7.0      release number for the archive name and manifest.json
    python release.py --no-python          no embedded Python (one must already be installed)
    python release.py --pynifly <folder>   take the add-on from here instead of looking for it
    python release.py --stage-only         stage the release folder and do not pack it
    python release.py --list               what would go into the archive, doing nothing
release.optPackage: Package kind: legacy full, immutable runtime, or application-only update.
release.optRuntimeFrom: Audited complete release or existing Runtime folder; copy exact bytes.
release.optRuntimeVersion: Independent Runtime version, changed only for native/runtime updates.
release.splitFlags: Split-only options cannot be mixed with legacy bundling options.
release.optLayout: Package layout: structured root/Morphbench (default), or legacy flat.
release.fullLayout: Structured archives use --package runtime or --package application. The legacy full format supports --layout flat only.
release.optNewRuntime: Create a deliberately new Runtime from a complete seed; cannot reuse an existing identity or Runtime manifest.
release.optSourceCommit: Exact 40-character source commit for release notices; defaults to the checkout HEAD.
release.packageReadmeFlat:
# Morphbench %(version)s

This package uses the legacy flat installation layout. For split distributions, place Application and a compatible Runtime in the same writable folder. A full distribution already includes both. Run %(entry)s; launch through MO2 to inspect virtual Data.

Close the server and launcher before updating. Preserve morphbench.json, launcher settings and the complete add-on directory, including its registry and generations. Use a fresh folder when migrating to the structured Morphbench layout.

[Installation](docs/install-layout.md) · [Updates](docs/updating.md) · [Quick start](docs/quickstart.md) · [Source and licences](SOURCE.md)
release.packageReadme:
# Morphbench %(version)s

Install Application and a compatible Morphbench Launcher into the same Morphbench folder. Both split archives start at root/Morphbench; copy Morphbench from inside root into a writable tools folder or game root. Keep files outside Data.

Run %(entry)s. Launch it through MO2 to inspect virtual Data. Optional Root Builder installation and state-preserving updates are described in [installation](docs/install-layout.md) and [updating](docs/updating.md). Close the server and launcher before updating.

Keep app/morphbench.json, launcher settings and the complete plugins directory when replacing packages. Existing flat installations require a fresh-folder migration to the structured layout.

[Quick start](docs/quickstart.md) · [User interface](docs/page.md) · [CLI](docs/cli.md) · [Source and licences](SOURCE.md)
release.sourceNotice:
# Source and licences

Morphbench is distributed under GNU GPL v3; see LICENSE. The installed Python and JavaScript are runtime source. Matching maintained source: [exact release commit](%(source)s). The launcher source and [build directions](%(building)s) are available there separately.

The separate Launcher includes its own RUNTIME-LICENSE, RUNTIME-THIRD-PARTY.md, dependency metadata and bundled licence texts. Preserve these notices when redistributing.
release.runtimeNotice:
# Morphbench Launcher: use, licences and source

Merge this archive with a compatible Morphbench Application in root/Morphbench. Run launcher/morphbench.exe from the merged Morphbench folder; launch through MO2 for virtual Data. Launcher v3 requires Application 0.8.7 or a newer compatible Application. When upgrading, install Application first, then replace Launcher. The native host uses protocol 1; Application schema2 requires launcher API1 / cp312-win_amd64. Close launcher/server before replacing packages; retain Application settings and the complete plugins directory. Application and Runtime versions are independent.

Morphbench launcher: GNU GPL v3, see RUNTIME-LICENSE. [Exact launcher source](%(source)s) and [build directions](%(building)s) are provided separately. Application runtime source is in its separate package.

Python %(python)s: PSF-2.0, see python/LICENSE.txt; source https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-%(pythonTag)s/. NumPy: BSD-3-Clause and bundled components, see vendor/numpy-*.dist-info/licenses/. Pillow: MIT-CMU and bundled components, see vendor/pillow-*.dist-info/licenses/ and its SBOM. Preserve every bundled licence text, including notices for native transitive dependencies.

PyNifly Python runtime: V28.1.0 at the [pinned source commit](%(wrapperSource)s). NiflyDLL is newly compiled from that wrapper source and [pinned Nifly library source](%(librarySource)s), with the [complete build recipe](%(recipeSource)s). Runtime metadata records both source commits, compiler and actual DLL hash. This is a new source-accounted build, not a reproduction of the historical upstream DLL. The matching native source is separately downloadable as morphbench-nifly-corresponding-source.zip beside this release. GNU GPL v3 applies; additional half/Miniball notices are in vendor/io_scene_nifly/NATIVE-LICENSES.txt.
